$comment: Validated 2026-09-30 against the implemented clone at git c223e50 (source frozen for extraction; see CODE_HEALTH.md Schedule). Order = DOM order on the live homepage (CLONE_SPEC §1.6). implementedBy points at the rendering component; section roots carry data-section ids listed in SELECTORS*.md. The ?popup=open|success|error query hook is a QA-only affordance, not a route or product state.

categories.SHELL: Page chrome and page-level layers: fixed navigation, mobile menu, background layers, modal, footer.
categories.HERO: Page-opening statement with the primary call to action.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: client logos, case-study spotlight, metrics, testimonials.
categories.PRODUCT: Explanation of how the product works and its agent modules.
categories.TRANSITION: Decorative full-width blocks that change the page between dark and light surfaces.
categories.FIT: Why the product fits the buyer: specialties, EMR integrations, security/compliance.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed 60px top bar with blurred translucent dark background: logo, Compare/Blog/Case Studies/Careers links, Login, green Book a Demo button; tweens to a white treatment while the white section is under it.

shell.mobile-menu.description: Full-screen overlay menu opened from the burger at ≤991px: large nav links, Login and Book a Demo bar; stops smooth scroll while open.
shell.mobile-menu.scope: Present on the 1 in-scope route, visible at tablet/mobile widths only.

shell.page-layers.description: Fixed hero background video (tablet render, still-image fallback under reduced motion) that fades out after the hero, plus the tiled noise overlay.

shell.call-alex-modal.description: Hidden fixed 'Call Alex' popup with name/email/phone form, client-side validation and success/error states (no network); opened from the hero and CTA 'Call Alex' links.

shell.footer.description: Footer top: rail with company description, Navigate/Legal/Social link columns and an email signup form (static, no network).

shell.footer-bottom-reveal.description: Sticky bottom bar revealed beneath the page as it scrolls away: oversized wordmark and legal row.

hero.home.description: Full-viewport dark hero over the fixed video: 6.5vw headline 'Maximize Every Call with a Custom AI Agent' and a bottom row with 'Who We Are' statement and 'Test Our AI Agent' phone input plus 'Call Alex' link.

proof.client-logos.description: Continuously scrolling marquee of client practice logos between hairlines.

proof.client-spotlight.description: Case-study spotlight heading ('Client Spotlight – Andrews Sports Medicine') with a click-to-load YouTube facade.

proof.stats.description: Four metric blocks in blue tints: hover expands a block and reveals its image on desktop; click accordion at ≤991.

proof.testimonials.description: Testimonial slider: photo block, quote, author with green title badge, practice logo, numbered prev/next arrows with cross-fade.

product.how-it-works.description: Scroll-stepped 'How it works' sequence where three large phrases highlight one at a time.

transition.black-to-white.description: Scroll-scrubbed pixel-grid transition from the dark page into the white section.

product.scheduling-agent.description: Agent #1 Scheduling: sticky card deck where earlier cards scale down, lift and tint as later cards scroll in.

product.tasking-agent.description: Agent #2 Tasking: 200vh half-split with auto-rotating vertical tabs (4s progress bar) and fading image panes; click tabs at ≤991.

product.navigator-agent.description: Agent #3 Navigator: four row tabs activated on hover, with the matching image in the left rail.

product.outreach-agent.description: Agent #4 Outreach: sticky left title panel with five sticky stacking cards in blue tints on the right.

transition.white-to-black.description: Scroll-scrubbed pixel-grid transition from the white section back to the dark page.

fit.specialties.description: 'Designed for Your Specialty': 13 hover-activated specialty tabs with a matching image pane, plus 'And other specialties'.

fit.integrations.description: 'Built to Connect': EMR/partner logos in two opposing marquee rows with hover background and logo swap; marketplace links open externally.

fit.security.description: 'Secure. Compliant. Trusted.': image rail and a 2×2 grid of certification cells with hover background and logo swap.

conversion.cta.description: Closing CTA over a background image revealed by a scroll-scrubbed pixel grid: agent list, 'Quick Start / Live in 60 Days', large headline, phone input with 'Call Alex' and 'Book a Demo'.
